course.title: Digital World
course.description: A free course with 17 lessons about AI and the digital world through social studies: where AI came from, who builds it and at what cost, how it changes daily life, and who decides how it is used.

sections.title: Thinking machines
sections.question: What is AI, and where did it come from?
sections.description: Find out what AI is, how people have tried to build thinking machines since the 1950s, how AI learns from examples, and what a large language model is.

sections.title: Who builds AI, and at what cost
sections.question: Who makes AI work, and who pays for it?
sections.description: Meet the people behind AI, weigh the power and water it uses, ask which languages it speaks, and see why it works better for some people than others.

sections.title: AI in daily life
sections.question: How is AI changing work, school and community life?
sections.description: Look at how AI changes jobs, health, farming and school, and weigh safety against privacy when cameras can recognise faces.

sections.title: Truth, power and choices
sections.question: Who decides what we see, and how AI is used?
sections.description: Check fake pictures and claims, see how feeds choose what we see, compare the rules people are making for AI, and plan an AI helper for a community.
